suite: Recommended and personal artwork choice contract

checks.name: the existing twelve pictures work before the art bridge is loaded
late-loaded art bridge adds all 28 examples without changing existing list/get callers
the same art ID distinguishes the child purple light from the recommended red light
an absent artwork resolves to its same example while preserving the requested source
new resolution observes edits/deletion while already returned pictures remain snapshots
pre-versioning saved artwork retains all fifteen original regions and fills
unknown IDs and forged saved SVG/paint cannot replace shipped artwork
caller mutations do not contaminate future choices or the canonical examples

limitations: Pure production catalog/bridge calls in a VM; browser rendering and audio are separate checks
